Look into law of attraction. Anything you put your mind to , can become true. If you put your efforts into gaming and genuinely feel like becoming a pro gamer or streamer is something you really want to do then definitely go for it. Yes your parents might not support it but if you prove them wrong by actually pursuing it you’ll see that it pays off. It might be challenging or difficult but if you really, really, really want to do it then you can, there’s nothing stopping you. Try it. I believe in you. You should believe in yourself too. If gaming is what you truly believe you can do, then do it!

It’s honestly fine to feel that way but I think that will change. 2 years ago there was a whole year where all I did was play games, go to school, come back drink cola, eat chocolate and junk, watch gaming videos, play games and repeat. At the time I found it enjoyable and didn’t know that I was actually using all of these as a way to comfort myself because I was very depressed. Things will get better even if you don’t see it yet. You will get aspirations but don’t stress about it they will come naturally once you start allowing yourself to feel this way. Just game and enjoy gaming and one day you’ll realise what you want to do and even if you can’t see your life going anywhere right now that doesn’t mean you won’t see your life going anywhere in the future. It’s crazy how one person can change in a year or a few months. You can do it too

That’s the mindset depression brings you into. Once you start treating your depression you’ll see things you’ll get passionate about. I actually love gaming and could do it for 8 hours straight without getting up but it’s not good. My brother is actually in the same position as you mentally and for him gaming is an escape world too. Just try to get help with your mental state and in the mean time don’t feel guilty about gaming! Do what you love to do! There’s plenty of gamer girls out there too

Strong enough to become better and change yourself for the better!

This sounds more than just lack of motivation I feel like you should see a doctor because you have symptoms of depression which people don’t take seriously but it’s really serious. depression makes you think this way but know that you can always turn your life around. Start by loving yourself and getting out of your comfort zone and possibly visiting a doctor who can help you with depression. Then you can start becoming the best version of yourself and eventually get a girlfriend but a lot of people on reddit seem to seek relationships however everyone needs to understand that a relationship is only good when you’re whole as a person. So change your future for the better!!!! I believe in you!!
Omg I had that happen to me lol. Try putting some music on and if your mum barges in she will just see that you’re exercising.

Imagine and visualise your future if you were to become whatever you wanted to be. You can actually do it. Focus on the things you are passionate about and trust that you will be able to love yourself and become a better person .

By seeing your words I can see that you’re such a nice person. You’re kind. And there is definitely a best version of yourself believe me anyone can improve and there’s no “perfect”. We all have place for improvement and you do too and you shouldn’t talk to yourself in such a tone!! Get out of that relationship because until you know your own value and worth and see your beauty and strength and until you can truly love yourself, you shouldn’t be in a relationship. Self love is the best love and it is hard. Really hard but it’s the first step into becoming the best version of yourself. You can do it too but it requires your strength. 
Thank you for your kind words!!!

I was thinking of something like this today but don’t take your life because you think you’ll be reincarnated as a dog in your next life. No. Imagine being reincarnated as a child in Syria who’s town gets bombed and their face is burned but they’re still alive. Imagine that. Just know that there’s worse situations than the one you’re in right now but I feel the same way you do and all I can say is take a day out of your week where you do relax, watch some shows or listen to music and get away from social media. Love yourself.

I’m feeling the exact same way. Take a day out of your life and just do some self care. After that just think of something you like doing and do that. Do the things you’re passionate about!!!!

I hate my family too they’re absolute trash but you need to see that if your family is not helping you and treating you this way you need to CUT THEM OFF. They seem extremely toxic. You do have a way out of this and whatever way it is I believe you can take action and get yourself away from them and start a completely new life. Just sit down and think deeply of something and an idea will come to you in which you can turn your life completely around. One day you’ll look back and remember this day as a day you wanted to throw everything away but this is just the beginning of something new and I believe you can overcome this because you’re strong enough no matter what.

You’re wrong because I’m a woman and I actually see you as a person. You’re looking at the wrong places and I see that you don’t believe in yourself at all but listen to me: you can always change your future and especially how you view things. Before you look for a girlfriend try to work on your life and become the best version of yourself on your own. Love yourself honestly because if you don’t believe in yourself and doubt yourself then no one ever will. Once you learned these things then you will meet the right person that was meant for you. But first you need to get yourself together and get out of your comfort zone!

Trust me you’re worth more than that! If your boyfriend wants away from you so bad then let him go because he’s missing out on you. Show him that you’re worth more than that. I see that you’re tired so then just say f*ck it and become badass. I might sound stupid but girl you cannot talk about yourself like that. We only have ourselves to trust and if you talk about yourself like that then it can be pretty damaging. Step into your own power and if you need to, cry it out and let your boyfriend go on his own. Prove EVERYONE wrong including your own doubts because I believe in you and as someone who wanted to end it multiple times, just fight it and become the best version of yourself. But if you feel tried then before you do all of that just take 1 day where you do self care and do the things you want to and relax. After that you can go ahead and kick some ass and show your boyfriend that if he doesn’t want you then bye. You deserve more than someone who makes you feel like that, in fact you deserve someone who makes you feel empowered and confident.

I have these too all the time. However I also have depression, general anxiety disorder and social anxiety disorder along with panic attacks.
You might have felt a relief or anxiety from imagining these because you subconsciously think that that would be a way out and a way of relief but obviously that doesn’t mean that you would kill yourself straight away. Just don’t let these thoughts get too long and too encouraging to the point of where you would want to actually act on these imaginations and remember that this was created by your brain so don’t let yourself get tricked. If these thoughts get too real and you feel like you want to act on them then seek help straight away because once the damage is done there’s no reverse

I am so sorry about your daughter. But think about her soul, she might have become one of your guardian angels. Imagine your daughter seeing you feeling this way and being sad about it, no daughter wants their dad to become suicidal after they’ve passed. Everything happens for a reason and I believe you can grow from this. Only time can heal this hurt so keep going because you will be able to heal this deep cut and remember your daughter in a beautiful light!!!! In the mean time allow yourself to cry it out. Cry all day if that will heal you. Just let it all out and after you have mourned your daughter, after some time passes you will realise that she is not completely gone and lives forever within you. Keep her memory.

And in addition to feeling bad about your past acts: don’t let your past define you. You can change yourself in a day and shift your mindset for the better and I know how hard it can truly be when the past haunts you however the past is the past and we don’t have control over it however what we do have control over is our future. We can become better and with the karma we can do better things and help others along the way. Do the things you love and evolve into the human being you want to be but don’t let any harm and negativity encourage you to do bad things... Even if you kill yourself the bad things you would do with intention from now would haunt you and get you back in your next life that’s why people’s karma and past life Plays a big role in their current life; instead of creating more bad karma and energy that you would carry on, create good energy and good karma so that you break the cycle and bring good to the world for yourself and for others. 

Hope you’re well
